balanced-crystalloids-vs-saline-mortalit.question: In critically ill adults, do balanced crystalloids reduce mortality versus 0.9% saline? (Randomised trials; double-blinding not required.)

colchicine-postop-af.question: In adults undergoing cardiac surgery, does peri-operative colchicine reduce postoperative atrial fibrillation versus placebo/usual care?

colchicine-secondary-cv-prevention.question: In adults with coronary disease or recent myocardial infarction, does low-dose colchicine reduce major adverse cardiovascular events versus placebo? (Double-blind placebo-controlled RCTs.)

corticosteroids-cap-mortality.question: In adults hospitalised with community-acquired pneumonia, do systemic corticosteroids added to standard care reduce all-cause mortality versus placebo or standard care?

corticosteroids-covid19-mortality.question: In hospitalised adults with COVID-19, do systemic corticosteroids reduce 28-day all-cause mortality versus usual care or placebo?

dapagliflozin-hfpef-hosp.question: In adults with heart failure and mildly reduced or preserved ejection fraction, does dapagliflozin reduce the composite of cardiovascular death or worsening heart failure versus placebo? (Double-blind placebo-controlled RCTs; HR estimand.)
population_any_terms: heart failure with mildly reduced or preserved ejection fraction
mildly reduced or preserved ejection fraction
left ventricular ejection fraction of more than 40%
heart failure with mildly reduced ejection fraction

denosumab-vertebral-fracture.question: In postmenopausal women with osteoporosis, does denosumab reduce new vertebral fractures versus placebo? (Double-blind placebo-controlled RCTs.)

doac-vte-recurrence.question: In adults with acute symptomatic venous thromboembolism (VTE), do direct oral anticoagulants change recurrent VTE versus warfarin / vitamin-K antagonist therapy?

dpp4-mace-t2d.question: In adults with type 2 diabetes, do DPP-4 inhibitors change 3-point major adverse cardiovascular events versus placebo? (Double-blind placebo-controlled RCTs.)

esketamine-trd-madrs.question: In adults with treatment-resistant depression, does intranasal esketamine added to an oral antidepressant reduce the MADRS depression score versus placebo added to an oral antidepressant? (Randomized double-blind trials; mean difference in MADRS points at the ~4-week induction endpoint.)

glp1-ra-mace-t2d.question: In adults with type 2 diabetes, do GLP-1 receptor agonists reduce 3-point major adverse cardiovascular events versus placebo? (Double-blind placebo-controlled RCTs.)

iv-iron-hfref-hosp.question: In adults with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction and iron deficiency, does intravenous iron reduce heart-failure hospitalization versus placebo or standard care?

metformin-pcos-ovulation.question: In women with polycystic ovary syndrome undergoing clomifene ovulation induction, does adding metformin to clomifene versus clomifene plus placebo increase ovulation rate? (Placebo-controlled RCTs.)

noac-vs-warfarin-af-stroke.question: In adults with non-valvular atrial fibrillation, do direct oral anticoagulants versus warfarin reduce stroke or systemic embolism? Pairwise direct comparison only, not network synthesis.

omega3-cardiovascular-events.question: In adults at cardiovascular risk, do marine omega-3 fatty acid supplements reduce major vascular events versus placebo/control? (Double-blind placebo-controlled RCTs.)

pcsk9-mace.question: In adults with or at high risk of ASCVD, do PCSK9 inhibitors (evolocumab or alirocumab) reduce major adverse cardiovascular events versus placebo? (Double-blind placebo-controlled RCTs.)

probiotics-aad-prevention.question: In patients receiving antibiotics, do probiotics reduce antibiotic-associated diarrhoea versus placebo or no probiotic?

sacubitril-valsartan-hfref.question: In adults with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction, does sacubitril/valsartan reduce the composite of cardiovascular death or heart-failure hospitalization versus an ACE inhibitor or ARB? (Double-blind active-controlled RCTs.)

semaglutide-obesity-mace.question: In adults with overweight or obesity and established cardiovascular disease but without diabetes, does semaglutide reduce 3-point major adverse cardiovascular events versus placebo? (Double-blind placebo-controlled RCTs.)
population_any_terms: cardiovascular outcomes in obesity without diabetes
overweight or obesity and established cardiovascular disease
cardiovascular disease and overweight or obesity
heart disease and stroke in patients with overweight or obesity

sglt2-primary-prevention-hf.question: In adults with type 2 diabetes or at cardiovascular risk in cardiovascular-outcome trials that include participants with and without baseline heart failure, do SGLT2 inhibitors reduce hospitalization for heart failure versus placebo?

spironolactone-hfref-mortality.question: In adults with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction, do spironolactone or eplerenone reduce all-cause mortality versus placebo? (Double-blind placebo-controlled RCTs.)

statins-primary-prevention-elderly.question: In older adults (>=70 years) without established cardiovascular disease, do statins versus placebo/control reduce major vascular events? (Evidence units include one whole trial and one pre-specified JUPITER older-adult subgroup.)

ticagrelor-vs-clopidogrel-acs.question: In adults with acute coronary syndrome, does ticagrelor reduce major adverse cardiovascular events, defined as the composite of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction, or stroke, compared with clopidogrel?

tocilizumab-covid19-mortality.question: In hospitalised adults with COVID-19, does tocilizumab reduce 28-day all-cause mortality versus usual care, standard care, or placebo?
